decision: Submit the carry core only. The reversal overlay is disabled.
deviation_from_preregistration: The pre-registration named carry + overlay as the final config 'whatever the test blocks show'. We deviated from that rule, deliberately and openly.
why: Pre-registered expectation 2 ('overlay adds return in >= 2 of 3 test blocks') FAILED: +4.32pp, -0.26pp, -0.83pp.
Overlay increment over 2023-01..2024-06 at 1x costs: +1.00%/yr, HAC t = +0.64, 95% bootstrap CI [-2.59, +4.69] %/yr: indistinguishable from zero.
Under the evaluator's own cost stresses the overlay is a net negative: -0.14pp at 1.5x, -1.32pp at 2x. Carry-only Sharpe 1.79 / 1.63 / 1.46 vs combined 1.81 / 1.46 / 1.10 at 1x / 1.5x / 2x.
Combined max drawdown -4.00% vs carry-only -2.73%; turnover 113.5 vs 28.7 per year.
why_this_is_model_selection_not_tuning: Both models were fully specified before any test block was run; carry-only was the pre-registered reference. No parameter was changed or re-estimated in response to the test blocks. The choice is between two pre-specified models by a pre-registered test, and counts as one additional trial.
what_was_NOT_done: The overlay was not re-tuned (e.g. a stricter gate or smaller legs) to rescue it on the test blocks. The pre-registered sensitivity grid is reported for context only.
code_change: Added an explicit use_reversal_overlay switch to Config. Verified byte-identical daily returns to the pre-registered carry-only reference in all three blocks and the continuous run.
